name: Nina Koebel
headline: Senior Practice Director, Vice President at Robert Half
about:
Personal Background:
As a breast cancer survivor of three years, diagnosed in my early 30s, I am a passionate advocate for women's health, women's rights, and human rights. I am also an avid social media enthusiast and a creative at heart. I hold both a Master of Arts in Public Policy and International Affairs, and Bachelor of Arts in Political Science (Legal Studies Option). 

Professional Experience:
With over 10 years of progressive experience, I am a dedicated and trusted recruitment partner specializing in finance and accounting sectors in downtown Toronto. I lead our team to excel in connecting candidates with rewarding opportunities and assisting clients in identifying top talent in competitive markets. I am a member of Robert Half's Chairman's Club, President's Club, Titanium Club and a Mission Possible Qualifier.

experiences.position: Senior Practice Director, VP - Finance, Accounting, Legal & Administrative
experiences.description:
I lead our Finance & Accounting, Legal, and Administrative & Customer Support practice groups in downtown Toronto. Our teams connect exceptional professionals with leading organizations. 

Whether you’re exploring your next career move or looking to hire top talent in any of these areas, I’d be happy to connect: nina.koebel@roberthalf.com

Robert Half is the world’s first and largest specialized recruitment firm, placing professionals in contract, contract-to-hire, and permanent roles across accounting and finance, technology, legal, administration, and creative & marketing disciplines. With 350+ offices worldwide, we’re dedicated to helping organizations find the right talent, and helping professionals find roles where they can thrive.

experiences.position: Senior Practice Director, VP - Finance & Accounting
experiences.description:
Responsible for oversight of our finance practice group and our accounting operations practice group in the downtown Toronto market. Our two teams specialize in the placement of senior level finance professionals, and entry to intermediate level finance and accounting (inclusive of payroll) professionals respectively.

Career Achievements:
I have generated over $5M CAD in career billings through 400+ full-time placements and strategic involvement in 700+ contract consulting assignments across diverse industries.
